settings.omdrop_bin.label: omdrop command
settings.omdrop_bin.description: Which omdrop to drive. A bare name is looked up on PATH, then at the Home Manager link in ~/.local/bin.
settings.active_interval.label: Polling while receiving
settings.active_interval.description: Seconds between status checks while an AirDrop window is open, or just after you press a button.
settings.idle_interval.label: Polling while idle
settings.idle_interval.description: Seconds between status checks when nothing is receiving. Lower values react faster but spawn more processes.
settings.action_grace_ms.label: Fast-poll window
settings.action_grace_ms.description: Milliseconds to keep polling quickly after a panel action, so the bar reflects the change at once.
settings.show_remaining.label: Show time left
settings.show_remaining.description: Put the remaining window time next to the bar glyph.
settings.duration.label: Default window
